info.name: MODO Sales Executive Mobile API v1
info.description: Sales app endpoints use /api/mobile/v1. Shared quotations, orders, customer-pos and batch-schedules are also available at /api/mobile using the main app token; sales authentication and app-specific endpoints remain under v1. Customer PO CRUD and PO-to-order conversion are included. See docs/mobile-commercial-api.md for the remaining route gaps. Set an ERP base_url, not the Sites preview URL. Run delete actions individually. Approval and rejection are alternative actions, and require a different reviewer. Author: ragul-onemodo.

request.description: An administrator must grant mobile app access for this email in Membership > Users first. Email/password login returns the bearer token directly. Alternative: Send WhatsApp OTP and Verify OTP. Notification behavior: this request does not directly trigger a business push notification.

exec: const d=pm.response.json().data || {}; if(d.token) pm.environment.set('api_token',d.token); if(d.challenge_id) { pm.environment.set('challenge_id',d.challenge_id); pm.environment.unset('api_token'); pm.environment.unset('otp'); }

request.description: Passwordless alternative. Mobile app access must be granted by an administrator first. Set mobile to a uniquely registered user number. Returns 202 after WhatsApp provider submission. Enter the received code in otp and run Verify OTP. Notification behavior: this request does not directly trigger a business push notification.

exec: const d=pm.response.json().data || {}; if(d.token) pm.environment.set('api_token',d.token); if(d.challenge_id) { pm.environment.set('challenge_id',d.challenge_id); pm.environment.unset('api_token'); pm.environment.unset('otp'); }

pm.test('WhatsApp OTP challenge accepted', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(202); const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.channel).to.eql('whatsapp'); pm.expect(d.challenge_id.length).to.eql(64); pm.expect(d.token).to.eql(undefined); });

Requires sales-mobile bearer token and X-Plant-Id. History is scoped to the user and plant. Use the sequential numeric notification ID (push_log_id). Live delivery uses Reverb while connected; FCM/APNs is not implemented. On tap map subject_type + subject_id to the app screen and load the record through its API; record permissions still apply. CrmLead -> GET /leads/{id}; Quotation -> GET /quotations/{id}; SalesOrder -> GET /orders/{id}; CustomerPO -> GET /customer-pos/{id}. There is no public send-test endpoint: create/update a disposable business record with the normal API, with PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED, Reverb and queue worker running. Filter live events by plant_id and refresh history on reconnect. Requires PUSH_NOTIFICATION.RECEIVE to subscribe. Only connect when enabled, configured and can_receive are true. Saves notification_channel; obtain socket_id from a real WebSocket connection before authorizing. Notification behavior: this request does not directly trigger a business push notification.

Notification behavior: successful CrmLead, Quotation or SalesOrder model creation/business update/deletion generates a notification per eligible recipient. One request may emit multiple events; a no-op, rejected request or rolled-back transaction emits none. Follow-up activity and batch-schedule writes are not notification sources. Recipient needs active plant membership and PUSH_NOTIFICATION.RECEIVE. Payload contains subject_type, subject_id, operation, reference and selected changes; navigate using the subject identity.

Attendance timestamps are stored and returned as YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss in 24-hour India time. Repeated punches preserve timestamps; one session per employee/work date.
